_comment: The promo video's narration, scene by scene. This file is the script:
edit the text here and re-render, no code changes needed.
id        matches a <section data-scene="id"> in storyboard.html
say       what the voice reads. Sentences are spoken one at a time with
a short breath between them; a line break (\n) is a longer one.
caption   the same line as plain text, for the .srt subtitle file
lead      silence before the line starts, seconds (the scene animates in)
tail      silence after the line ends, seconds (the scene holds)
beats     the sentence starts and the end of speech, scene-local, that the
scene's animation delays in storyboard.html were written against.
The renderer bends each scene's clock so cues still land on their
sentence after the voice is re-read faster or re-worded; only a
change in the NUMBER of sentences needs the beats re-recorded.
Scene length is lead + spoken length + tail, measured at render time, so
the picture always follows the voice rather than a hand-written duration.
voice.engine is `kokoro` (Kokoro-82M, a neural voice run locally through
kokoro-js; first run downloads the model into node_modules) or `say`
(the macOS system voice, a fallback). Kokoro voices worth trying: af_heart,
